A friend of Muriel's tried to escape from the Plains of Havoc, but did not make it out alive. His body is half-hidden by a tree, west of the camp of cyclopes, orcs and minotaurs. Open it to receive an {item:Iron Helmet}, a {item:Sudden Death Rune}, a {item:Leather Armor}, the book {item:Porgol's Strange Behaviour (Book)|Porgol's Strange Behaviour}, some {item:Worn Leather Boots} and a {item:Longsword}.
